intelligence.essence: The primary pattern — the stage with the flow behind it, moving back and forth — now has its two sizes: short boards get the stage; longer ones get the whole wrap all the way around. Text boards work within the frame, below the headline, in three shapes: one full board, three equal thirds in the centre, or two rectangles. On the Inviter, the bottom-bar icon popup STAYS — where you stop, it's there — and the Step 1–4 buttons stay and jump to their section, with more than four sections allowed, multiple parts per step. And the universal hub/template is CLONABLE TO INFINITY — useful, helpful and powerful for anybody.
